title: A Day in My Garden
text:
Hello, friends! Today I want to write about my small garden. I have tomatoes, carrots, and some flowers. Every morning I water the plants before work.

On Saturday, a friend visited and helped me plant new seeds. We also talked about cooking, and she gave me a good recipe. I hope my vegetables grow well this summer.

questions.text: What does the writer grow in the garden?
Who visited the writer on Saturday?
What can we infer about the writer?
options: The writer has no space for a garden
The writer is not interested in food

questions.text: Why does the writer hope the vegetables will grow well?
options: Because the writer wants to eat them
Because the vegetables will be sold
Because the garden belongs to a school
Because the writer is moving away

vocabulary.definition: a small piece of land where plants and flowers are grown
to pour water on plants so they can grow
small parts of a plant from which new plants grow

paragraph_translations: Merhaba arkadaşlar! Bugün küçük bahçem hakkında yazmak istiyorum. Domatesim, havucum ve birkaç çiçeğim var. Her sabah işe gitmeden önce bitkilere su veriyorum.
Cumartesi günü bir arkadaşım geldi ve yeni tohumlar ekmeme yardım etti. Ayrıca yemek pişirmeyi konuştuk ve bana güzel bir tarif verdi. Bu yaz sebzelerimin iyi büyümesini umuyorum.
